skill: door_push
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_door
  anchor: world
  offset:
  - 0.09
  - 0.18
  - 0.35
  weight: 0.2
- id: push_door
  anchor: fixture
  target_entity: hinge
  metric: hinge_angle
  weight: 0.8
phases:
- id: approach_contact
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: force_threshold_switch
  termination: force_exceeded
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: world
    offset:
    - 0.09
    - 0.18
    - 0.35
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: world_z
  parameters:
    approach_force_threshold:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 3.0
      - 15.0
      default: 5
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.force_threshold
        mode: replace
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_door
- id: push_door
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.35
      axis: task_goal_direction
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: positive
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.2
      - 0.5
      default: 0.35
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: force_compliance
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 25.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: reduce_speed
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: push_door
